policies.name: Main is Protected
policies.description: No feature work is committed directly to main.

conditions.message: Feature work on main is forbidden (Rule 1). Create a feature branch.

policies.name: Branch Naming Policy
policies.description: Feature branches use the feature/ or fix/ or chore/ prefix.

conditions.message: Branch '{branch}' does not match feature/*, fix/*, chore/*, docs/*.

policies.name: One Objective Per Branch
policies.description: A feature branch serves exactly one objective declared in the objective lock.

conditions.message: Objective lock branch does not match current branch.
